n = int(input())
data_array = list(map(int, input().split()))
interval_limit = int(input())

data_array.sort()

max_group = 0
for start_index in range(n):
    current_count = 0
    for j in range(start_index, n):
        if data_array[j] <= data_array[start_index] + interval_limit:
            current_count += 1
    max_group = max(max_group, current_count)
